commands.name: commit
commands.description: Review and commit the current changes
commands.prompt: Inspect git status and diff in the current directory. Stage the relevant changes, write a clear commit message in the repository's existing style, and create the commit. Do not push and do not touch unrelated files.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review uncommitted changes for bugs and risks
commands.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes in this directory. Look for correctness issues, regressions, security problems, and missing tests. Report findings with file and line references. Do not modify files.
